market_analysis.market_type_reason: The market is hybrid because rescue equipment is sold to commercial and institutional buyers like fire departments and search teams, but B2C was chosen because it also has a genuine consumer-facing side serving individual outdoor enthusiasts, hobbyist climbers, and emergency preppers.
market_analysis.market_definition: The rescue equipment industry comprises companies that design, produce, and supply specialized tools, gear, and systems used to extract, stabilize, and protect individuals in emergency or hazardous situations.
market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer was chosen because the landscape is built around companies that produce physical devices, tools, and materials under their own names, whereas distributors and service providers only facilitate the delivery or training of these physical products.
